target.statement: AVAR-Thinker achieves 74.7% accuracy on MathVista, a +6.5% gain over Qwen2.5-VL-7B (68.2%)

compute.basis: Reproducing the headline number requires the full AVAR pipeline: cold-start training on 30.6K samples for 20 epochs on 16 A100 GPUs, followed by RL for 4 epochs on 17.9K samples on the same hardware, then evaluation on MathVista; this is far beyond a laptop's capability.

blockers: Requires 16 A100 GPUs for cold-start and RL training
Training data synthesis uses Gemini 2.5-Pro and Qwen3-235B-A22B, which are closed or very large models
No released training code or data; only model weights are available
title: From Narrow to Panoramic Vision: Attention-Guided Cold-Start Reshapes Multimodal Reasoning
